labels.shortDescription: Import run log: some rows were matched through duplicate rules
labels.value: Your duplicate rules matched some rows to a person or organization the matching rule did not find. Their Matched By Duplicate Rule box is ticked: check them in the import's rows before you commit.

labels.shortDescription: Import run log: no duplicate rule could be asked about people
labels.value: Your duplicate rules were not asked about people: no rule for them is switched on, or Salesforce could not run it. People were matched by the matching rule alone.

labels.shortDescription: Import run log: no duplicate rule could be asked about organizations
labels.value: Your duplicate rules were not asked about organizations: no rule for them is switched on, or Salesforce could not run it. Organizations were matched by the matching rule alone.

labels.shortDescription: Import row: duplicate rules matched both people to one record
labels.value: Your duplicate rules matched both people on this row to the same record. Put them on separate rows, or untick Also match with my duplicate rules, and import the row again.

labels.shortDescription: Import run log: duplicate rules matched some one-object rows
labels.value: Your duplicate rules matched some rows to a record you already have, so those rows update it instead of creating a new one. Their Matched By Duplicate Rule box is ticked: check them in the import's rows before you commit.

labels.shortDescription: Import run log: no duplicate rule could be asked about the object
labels.value: Your duplicate rules were not asked: no rule for this object is switched on, or Salesforce could not run it. Rows were matched by their record ID or key alone.

labels.shortDescription: Import row: duplicate rules matched several records
labels.value: Your duplicate rules matched more than one record for this row, and the template says to reject such a row. Merge the duplicates, or choose Use the most recently changed.

labels.shortDescription: Import row: duplicate rules matched a record another row loads
labels.value: Your duplicate rules matched this row to a record an earlier row already loads. Combine the rows, or untick Also match with my duplicate rules, and import the row again.

labels.shortDescription: Import wizard: what matching one object with duplicate rules does
labels.value: Your org's duplicate rules can match an existing record, which is then updated. Check the dry run.

labels.shortDescription: Import row: duplicate rules could not be checked
labels.value: Your duplicate rules could not be checked for this row (Salesforce could not run them), so it was not loaded rather than risk a duplicate. Import it again later, or untick Also match with my duplicate rules.

labels.shortDescription: Import row: duplicate rule match already has another key; {0} is the key field
labels.value: Your duplicate rules matched this row to a record whose {0} already holds a different value, which loading the row would overwrite. Check which record is right, fix the file or the record, and import the row again.
